articles.title: Letter: The Book Exchange Box on Yardley Lane Needs Attention
body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the August meeting. Please keep the book exchange box in the budget. Many of us on Yardley Lane use it every week.

Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. To the editor: I have lived on Yardley Lane for 32 years, and I want to say what a difference the Stonebridge Trail Crew has made.
Gordon Demetriou, Foxglove Heights
